versions.changelog:
Initial release for instruction-web.

- Adds workflow to create HTML web operation guides for Web UIs, feature walkthroughs, and agent import tutorials.
- Enforces unified output directory (workplace-doc) and file placement.
- Automatically triggers when user requests guides, instructions, interface introductions, or agent import help.
- Generates visually appealing HTML with screenshot placeholders, cards, badges, code blocks, and step guides.
- Provides GitHub push instructions and generates CDN/preview links for sharing finished guides.
